limitations: A dated snapshot of public responses. No monitoring schedule, search-provider index/ranking/traffic data, verified crawler visits, or AI citation study is included.
Synthetic User-Agents come from the audit network, not verified provider IPs. A successful request does not prove real crawler access, indexing, ranking or citation.
All declared sitemap families are parsed and counted, but only selected route and link cohorts are fetched. Counts are explicit denominators, not an SEO/GEO performance score.

HTML inspection uses dependency-free bounded markup parsing. Candidate server text is not computed CSS visibility or browser rendering; JavaScript interactions, screenshots, schema.org rich-result eligibility and accessibility are not tested here.

No credentials, cookies, authorization headers, wallet signing, payments, mutations or POST requests. Expected authentication/payment/method/preview gates do not certify their authorized runtime behavior.

Source-informed findings use public repository file URLs for rationale. Runtime public observations are timestamped; generation timestamps and sitemap lastmod are not assumed to prove editorial freshness.
HTTP/XML/JSON syntax and contract checks do not establish factual truth, rights, editorial quality, full endpoint coverage or provider support for custom agents.json/llms formats.

references.title: AI features and your website
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Label text availability, source clarity and discovery as readiness; keep Google index and AI citation outcomes unmeasured without provider evidence.

references.title: Google Search technical requirements
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Separate public indexable pages from intentionally private or gated services when selecting the denominator.

references.title: How Google interprets the robots.txt specification
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Evaluate effective path permission per bot. Do not assume a named bot inherits wildcard restrictions.

references.title: Robots meta tags, data-nosnippet, and X-Robots-Tag specifications
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Check response headers and initial/rendered HTML. Missing an explicit index tag is not a defect.

references.title: Build and submit a sitemap
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Count sitemap files and distinct listed URLs separately from fetched pages. Track advertised, reachable, valid and sampled URLs with their own denominators.

references.title: How to specify a canonical URL with rel="canonical" and other methods
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Treat conflicting or wrong canonicals as actionable signals. Classify an absent self-canonical as a consistency opportunity, not automatic deindexing.

references.title: Understand the JavaScript SEO basics
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Compare the initial response with browser-rendered text and links. A successful browser visit alone does not prove all crawlers see the same content.

references.title: General structured data guidelines
references.summary: Audit interpretation: JSON parsing and counting types only establishes syntax/presence; semantic suitability and provider validation remain separate checks.

references.title: List of Google's common crawlers
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Do not run a 'Google-Extended HTTP crawler' probe or score its permission as Google Search permission.

references.title: Verify requests from Google crawlers and fetchers
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Verified server logs and provider tooling can establish actual crawler access; an audit request with a copied UA cannot.

references.title: Overview of OpenAI Crawlers
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Keep search, training and user-directed access distinct, and leave policy changes to the owner.

references.title: Does Anthropic crawl data from the web, and how can site owners block the crawler?
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Do not infer search access from ClaudeBot permission alone, or apply Google's Crawl-delay behavior to Anthropic.

references.title: How to verify Bingbot
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Label Bing UA-only requests as synthetic. Do not assert verified Bingbot access from them.

references.title: Introducing AI Performance in Bing Webmaster Tools Public Preview
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Provider analytics could support a later measured GEO view. Without authorized data, show citation performance as not measured.

references.title: Bing introduces support for the data-nosnippet HTML attribute
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Respect intentional premium-content preview restrictions; do not equate them with a site-wide outage.

references.title: The /llms.txt file, v2
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Assess existing files for truth, freshness, resolvable links and consistency. Treat missing or stale files as agent-usability findings without invented GEO effects.

references.title: OpenAPI Specification v3.2.1
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Validate the service's declared version, endpoints, methods, response contracts and authentication descriptions. An OpenAPI document is integration evidence, not proof of AI-search visibility.

references.title: MCP specification (2025-11-25)
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Test advertised protocol functionality only within authorized read-only scope. A manifest or HTTP endpoint alone does not demonstrate a working MCP handshake or search discoverability.

references.title: Perplexity Crawlers
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Show search crawling and user-triggered retrieval as different roles. A copied User-Agent from this audit network does not verify a Perplexity source.

references.title: About Applebot
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Assess Applebot-Extended as a robots data-use policy token, not a separate HTTP crawler probe.

references.title: Frequently Asked Questions
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Server-readable text matters to this crawler. A successful CCBot-labelled audit request does not establish a genuine Common Crawl visit or inclusion in its sampled dataset.

references.title: About AmazonBot
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Describe Amazonbot as an Amazon crawler with its documented data-use scope, and keep search/user-fetch roles and verified source evidence separate.

references.title: Product snippet structured data
references.summary: Audit interpretation: A missing required property affects possible Product snippet eligibility, not ordinary page indexability. Check the applicable page type and truthful visible data before suggesting markup changes.

references.title: Merchant listing structured data
references.summary: Audit interpretation: Apply the requirements for the intended feature and actual buying experience. Never convert an unknown or null price into a fictitious zero price, or invent ratings or stock availability.
